=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text a1 "thisisatest"
text b1 "testing123testing"
text a2 "1234"
text b2 "1224533324"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note fill writes the (len a + 1) x (len b + 1) length table into t, row-major with width len b + 1;
note both lengths up to 63
fn fill a view uchar * b view uchar * t edit ulong 4096 to void
w = add len b 1
for i ulong len a
for j ulong len b
up = add mul i w add j 1
x = add get t sub up 1 1
if ne get a i get b j
x = get t up
l = get t add up sub w 1
if lt x l
x = l
end
end
put t add up w x
end
end
end
note goup: the cell above is at least the cell to the left
fn goup t view ulong 4096 i ulong j ulong w ulong to bool
u = get t add mul sub i 1 w j
ret ge u get t add mul i w sub j 1
end
note walk goes back from the corner of the table: a match is taken, otherwise the larger neighbour,
note the upper one on a tie. The subsequence is written into o back to front.
fn walk a view uchar * b view uchar * t view ulong 4096 o edit uchar 64 to void
w = add len b 1
i = len a
j = len b
k = get t add mul i w j
while and gt i 0 gt j 0 bound 200
if eq get a sub i 1 get b sub j 1
k = sub k 1
put o k get a sub i 1
i = sub i 1
j = sub j 1
else
if goup t i j w
i = sub i 1
else
j = sub j 1
end
end
end
end
fn lcs a view uchar * b view uchar * to void
t = new ulong 4096 0
fill a b t
o = new uchar 64 0
n = get t add mul len a add len b 1 len b
walk a b t o
emit part o 0 n
emit nl
end
fn main to int
lcs a1 b1
lcs a2 b2
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
tsitest
1234
</pre>
